Please read the following multiple-choice questions and provide the most likely correct answer based on the options given.

Context: None

Question: Wound drainage should be assessed for volume and consistency:

Options: 
A. only when there is visible leakage through the dressing.
B. daily.
C. each time post-operative observations are undertaken.
D. every hour.
E. every time the patient eats.
F. only when the patient reports pain.
G. only when the wound dressing is changed.
H. only when the patient has a fever.

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
